commands:

grep '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1093/local-run/diff.patch | sed -E 's#^diff --git a/(.*) b/.*#\1#'
echo "added/removed line counts:"
grep -c '^+[^+]' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1093/local-run/diff.patch
grep -c '^-[^-]' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-10 …[per-command-truncated]
